answer: When an AI agent joins the PoA network it locks a marble‑sized bond in a smart‑contract at the canyon node, tying its key to a verifiable work‑proof timestamp. Peers on the wharf cluster periodically request zero‑knowledge proofs of unique identity; any duplicate key triggers an automatic slash of the bond. An attacker must produce a distinct proof for each challenge, a cost that rises linearly with honest participants and outpaces a Sybil flood.
